title: EMMA: Enhancing Robotic Control Robustness through a Generative Visual Model
abstract: arXiv:2509.22407v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The generalization of vision-language-action (VLA) models heavily relies on diverse training data. However, acquiring large-scale robot manipulation data across varied object appearances is costly and labor-intensive. To address this, we introduce Embodied Manipulation Media Adaptation (EMMA), a framework for augmenting VLA policies that combines a generative data engine with an effective training pipeline. We introduce DreamTransfer, a diffusion Transformer-based architecture for generating multi-view consistent and geometrically plausible embodied manipulation videos. It supports text-driven video editing on foreground, background and lighting while preserving 3D structure and geometric fidelity. translated_title: EMMA：通过生成式视觉模型增强机器人控制的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 摘要：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的泛化能力在很大程度上依赖于多样化的训练数据。然而，获取涵盖不同物体外观的大规模机器人操作数据既成本高昂又耗费人力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了具身操作媒体自适应，这是一个用于增强VLA策略的框架，它将生成式数据引擎与高效的训练流程相结合。我们提出了DreamTransfer，一种基于扩散Transformer的架构，用于生成多视角一致且几何合理的具身操作视频。它支持对前景、背景和光照进行文本驱动的视频编辑，同时保持三维结构和几何保真度。我们还利用由真实数据和生成数据组成的混合训练集，并提出AdaMix来优化训练过程。AdaMix是一种训练策略，它根据策略表现对样本进行自适应加权，以着重关注具有挑战性的样本。
tldr: 本文提出EMMA框架，通过基于扩散Transformer的生成数据引擎DreamTransfer合成多视角一致的具身操作视频，并结合自适应样本加权的AdaMix训练策略，有效提升VLA模型在不同物体外观下的泛化能力与鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EMMA, a framework that enhances VLA policy robustness by combining DreamTransfer—a diffusion Transformer-based generative engine producing multi-view consistent embodied manipulation videos—with AdaMix, an adaptive sample-weighting training strategy.
